'''Rock''' is the strongest [[troll]] on [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]]. As he is the strongest troll in the area, caution is advised when fighting him, as he can hit a max of 1890 and has a fair amount of life points. Since he only attacks with melee, [[Protect from Melee]] or [[Deflect Melee]] may help. Like the rest of the "big, bad" trolls in the area, such as [[Stick]], [[Pee Hat]], and [[Kraka]], he may drop a [[rune warhammer]] or [[granite shield]].

Since trolls are named after the first thing they eat, he probably ate a rock.
